games.name: Pack Party
games.description: The drawing party game where you and your friends make a deck of absurd cards to answer ridiculous prompts. 4 to 10 players.

games.name: Bouture
games.description: Potted plants that live on your Windows desktop. They grow over days and weeks, droop when you forget them, and flower if you keep watering. Double-click a plant to water it.

games.name: Railtown
games.description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

games.name: Leif's Garden Tower
games.description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

games.name: Dump Chaos
games.description: Dig through piles of junk, place the items you find on their proper shelves, and sell them to make money. Take your time organizing, add rare finds to your collection, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of turning chaos into order.

games.name: Card Dice
games.description: An idle progression game with a casino dice theme. Let your card dice roll automatically and beat opponents in timed matches. Collect gems and engravings to create different builds, trade up your equipment, and advance to higher-level tables.

games.name: Meteor Shower
games.description: Blast away never-ending hordes of falling meteors in this incremental tower defense game! Smash rocks to pieces with railguns, flak cannons, giant lasers and more as you work to defend your base from the stellar onslaught.

games.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads
games.description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

games.name: Unhistorical Warfare
games.description: Command 30+ historical armies across 3,000 years of warfare, from Persian spearmen to Abrams tanks, in real-time pixel-art battles where every soldier fights and flees on his own. Then deploy the anomalies: trolls, zombies, wizards, flying saucers and more!

games.name: Super Tag
games.description: Tag, with super powers! Super Tag is a 2D chase platformer: swing, blink and wall-jump away from the endless hord, or hunt down your friends in multiplayer mode.

games.name: Gotta Catch Bugs!
games.description: Gotta Catch Bugs! is a cozy first-person bug-catching game. A mutant plant has overgrown an underground lab and broken the control panel - 5,000 mutant insects are on the loose. Catch them with a net and jar, return all 500 species to their terrariums and unlock their powers!

games.name: Catch the Button
games.description: Make aim practice fun! Warm up before your next match, sharpen your reflexes, improve your mouse accuracy and enjoy chaotic arcade challenges. Train your aim while having fun!

games.name: CRUMBKINS
games.description: A 1–4 player physics-based co-op heist comedy about tiny, hungry thieves. Climb giant furniture, steal food for picky clients, and decide: deliver the loot, throw it to a friend, or eat a pepper and shoot fireballs.

games.name: Chalk Thrower Simulator
games.description: Keep a sleepy class awake by throwing chalk then a duster to finish. Draft perks between periods, climb twelve Standards, outlast Detention, race the Daily or crack 32 chalk puzzles. Solo, online co-op or versus.

games.name: DeepSeaFishery
games.description: A deep-sea idle fishing game. Cast, let your fish grow and your crew work while you are away. Descend from the shallows to coral reefs, polar ice and volcanic vents, collecting 252 species. Hire helpers, upgrade your gear, then retire to trade the run for permanent talents.

games.name: Fine Tuning: A Radio Repair Shop
games.description: Run a little radio repair shop in 1952, where every wireless on your bench is a working circuit, so the meter reads what's really there and the hum or the crackle you hear is the fault itself. You take each set apart by hand and fit new parts from the cabinet till it plays again for its owner.

games.name: No Sleep Tonight
games.description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

games.name: YinShu
games.description: Played The Message? YinShu is a free online social deduction card game inspired by it, for 4–8 players. Everyone hides a faction and passes intel; read friend from foe in who accepts and who refuses. Intercept, see through and swap intel with character skills. Collect three of your color to win.

games.name: Baggage Belt
games.description: Grow a tiny pixel-art airport all the way to the stars in this cozy idle game. Check in bags, hire the crew and book routes that multiply your income. Every airport has its own minigame, and the belt keeps running while you're away. Your crew chief is a corgi called Biscuit.

games.name: Tidal Life
games.description: Tidal Life is a first person open world exploration game. On this vast and boundless island, you must survive through diving, fishing, and beachcombing. Use the resources you gather to upgrade your equipment, complete the illustrated guide, enrich your island. collect or defeat them all !

games.name: SHAPE & SHADE
games.description: SHAPE & SHADE is a multiplayer game that combines Prop Hunt and Social deduction mechanics, draw your own disguise and survive until de train reach the Station. Watch your friends slowly go crazy trying to figure out what's real and what’s not !

games.name: Sanatorium of Evil
games.description: The monsters just wanted a quiet soak. Then heroes barged in with their "Purification". A pixel-art bullet heaven: draw trail signs with your steps, evolve weapons and hold out until 21:00. Then write the intruders a referral: STRAIGHT TO TRAUMATOLOGY!

games.name: Elysian Realms
games.description: A pixel-art tower defense for PC. Hold the road across seven realms. Each one changes a rule of the game, not the scenery. Every run, won or lost, feeds a skill tree that carries over to the next. No account, no telemetry: it runs on your machine and nowhere else.

games.name: Sigildeep
games.description: A deckbuilding dungeon crawler where every card is a spell on the front and a piece of the dungeon on the back. Lay cards down to build the way forward, fight with what you didn't spend, win packs and build better decks.

games.name: Mimic Hunt
games.description: Mimic Hunt is a multiplayer stealth game where you blend into crowds of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and outsmart your opponents across different game modes. Play as a Hider or Hunter, team up with friends in co-op or compete against other players.

games.name: The Heir's Guild
games.description: A turn-based RPG Roguelite where your choices will pave the path to victory! The Dragon Queen Tiametia threatens to take control of Realm... It is up to you, the Heir, to rally three loyal subjects to battle your way back to the Grand Palace and put an end to her tyranny!

games.name: RATS
games.description: Hide from your friends in the dark. Find the parts, feed the terminal and get out, while one or two of them hunt you by sound as one of nine killers. No markers, no waypoints: only your torch, your phone and what you hear.

games.name: Babel Rising Reborn
games.description: Humanity wants to reach the heavens. You're God. Make them regret it. Unleash the elements and bring the Tower of Babel crashing down in this remastered god game, more spectacular than ever. The Unreal Engine 5 remake of a cult god game.

games.name: Take Care!!!
games.description: A chaotic co-op pharmacy sim for 1–4 players. Serve patients, fill prescriptions, hit your quotas—and pray nobody loses it. Turn mounting stress into a resource and somehow make it to closing time!

games.name: 내일의 챔피언 (Tomorrow's Champion)
games.description: We've all dreamed of racing our own mini car, haven't we? Build and tune your mini racer, discover hidden Overdrives, and outsmart rivals with strategic pit stops. Race your way to the championship! BOOST ON!

games.name: Sortman
games.description: A Swiss sorting hall buried under a million letters and parcels. Sort by hand, weigh, throw, load the vans, answer furious customers, then build a chain of belts and machines that fills the vans by itself. Solo or up to four players, no timer.

games.name: Cupid's Bargain
games.description: A matchmaker summons a pair of devilishly fine deities to help save her dying club because, like, who needs a soul anyway? Go fall in love and sell your classmates’ souls in this horror romantic comedy!

games.name: Gravith
games.description: Gravith is a high-difficulty score attack game. Use the gravity of your mouse cursor (planet) to alter the path of incoming missiles and destroy targets. However, if a missile hits your planet, it's an instant game over. Experience high-risk gameplay where one slip-up ends it all.

games.name: Hurlyburly
games.description: Throw swords. Fall. Pick a card. Come back meaner. Hurlyburly is a top-down party brawler for 2–8 players where dying is how you upgrade and 150+ stacking cards turn every match into chaos.

games.name: Thirst Game
games.description: Good evening, viewers! Welcome to The Thirst Games! Tonight’s lucky contestants are you and your unlucky friends! Place your bets, run the gauntlet, trip each other up—and see who gets rich overnight and who ends up as roadkill.

games.name: Consume p/pixelplace
games.description: Hack a fully simulated pixel canvas. Build your botnet, spread the Void, and watch fictional communities fight, rebuild, and complain on Pixxit. A single-player incremental game with active and Idle modes, territorial drama, and far too many crabs.

games.name: Test Your Luck: Gacha Simulator
games.description: Welcome to GachaOS, the premier gacha gaming platform for whales! Play a gauntlet of incremental gacha games with Moby, our helpful Gacha Assistant. Build your fortune, then burn it all pulling characters, ripping packs, or opening crates. Unlucky? With GachaOS, turn your misfortune into fortune!

games.name: ONE BRAINCELL
games.description: Two bodies. One brain. Zero common sense. ONE BRAINCELL is a 2-player online co-op puzzle platformer where only one of you can think at a time. Pass the brain, steal it at the worst moment, yell secret codes across the room and fail gloriously together.

games.name: Sunday Socks
games.description: Sunday Socks is a cosy first-person tidying game. Socks are scattered all over the house: find each sock's twin, roll the pair into a ball and toss it into the Pair-O-Matic. Unlock upgrades, get help from the little Sock Bot and race for the fastest clear on the Steam leaderboards.

games.name: CatCat Panic
games.description: CatCat Panic is a chaotic online party game for 3–4 players! Pick your cat and battle your friends in 14 crazy mini-games: rob Nazif’s house, escape the vacuum monster, hop on your skateboard and race. Only one cat takes the crown!

games.name: Single File
games.description: A pixel-art auto-battler. You get one save file. If your party wipes, it's deleted and you start over. Not quite from zero though cause the Scrolls you earned stay, and they make every new file stronger. Grow a party of six. Use their abilities. Fight against 36 bosses.

games.name: CarCity
games.description: Run your own neighborhood car garage. Fix customers' cars, buy and customize your dream rides at the dealership, and race them down the drag strip. Grow from a single lift to the best shop in town, one job at a time.

games.name: Shutterbug Skies: Idle Camping
games.description: A cozy corner idler built to be your daily desktop companion. Help Kes search for and photograph beautiful bugs while you work, study, or relax. Upgrade your camera equipment, complete your creature collection, and discover 7 unique floating islands!

games.name: Nook Beasts
games.description: Digital monsters in the corner of your desktop! Hatch, Evolve, and Raise over 100 different beasts, and send them on adventures to grow stronger, earn rewards to upgrade your nook, and discover eggs from unknown species!

games.name: CATLINES
games.description: You're part of the sorting service, it's your final day on the job! Build your way through different worlds, use your skills, and deliver 8,196 cat-boxes to their owners. Drink milk, enjoy chocolate mint, sort every last cat-box to discover the mysterious gift waiting for you!

games.name: Tidy Up The Christmas Shop
games.description: Tidy up a cozy Christmas shop solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op! Find, carry and sort thousands of festive objects across 765 item types. Upgrade your gift sack, unlock a little Christmas magic, and bring order to the holiday chaos, one shelf at a time.

games.name: The Cardkov
games.description: Turn poker hands into weapons in this single-player, top-down extraction shooter. Collect discarded cards in the city's cold back alleys, build a hand, and use your new weapon to uncover the factory's secrets. Grab one more card, or make it back alive with the hand you've got.

games.name: Wild Myth
games.description: An online co-op adventure where you and your friends hunt for proof of the world’s most dangerous myths. All for the views. Go live. Capture the chaos. Run. Cut it into viral content. Stay live. Stay alive.

games.name: Sardoinky
games.description: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

games.name: Bar of Betrayal
games.description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.

games.name: Simple Tech Startup
games.description: Found a small game studio in 1975 and grow it into an industry giant. Build rooms on your own lot, hire a team, create your own engines and release games, while loans, taxes and rival companies keep you on your toes as the decades roll on into the age of AI.

games.name: DELF
games.description: Explore a dark and dangerous cave with your team. Gather resources, craft equipment, and manage your oxygen and stamina. Evade the creature lurking in the depths, work together, and find your way out alive!

games.name: STRAY BULLET
games.description: Free-to-play cartoon shooter where YOU are the bullet. Hop, blast off with gunpowder, fly on flames and go kamikaze in online matches for up to 20 players, with bots and local split screen. 28 weapons, 5 maps, 4 modes. No pay-to-win.

games.name: Study With Me: Online
games.description: Your new favorite place to study. Create an avatar and share a cozy multiplayer library with friends while you work on real-life goals. Mix 80+ clothing and footwear options, bring your books and music, then unwind with coffee or chess.

games.name: SearchBattle
games.description: Search, turned into a battle. SearchBattle is a word party game for 1–8 players on a real search engine. Everyone searches one word for the same topic; hit counts and results decide the winner. Across many rules, what's tested isn't knowledge but "search power." What would you search?

games.name: The Useless Game
games.description: A completely useless videogame that politely asks you not to download it.

games.name: Tasty Business
games.description: In Tasty Business, turn small restaurants into a culinary empire. Manage your businesses, source fresh ingredients, and attract customers as you expand your empire. Challenges, flavors, and new connections await. Are you ready to become the culinary mogul?

games.name: Shaft Nine
games.description: Work the shift. Meet the quota. Go a little deeper. A 2D pixel art mining game about a job that gets stranger the further down you go: less automation, more discovery, and secrets that don't stay underground.

games.name: Desert Diggers
games.description: Dig out a lost Egyptian city with up to 7 friends! Shovel deformable sand, haul fragile treasures together, survive cave-ins, snakes and sandstorms, and bury your friends alive when they least expect it. Dynamite is cheap. Friendships are not.

games.name: Little St. Files Mayhem
games.description: The Oval Office has a paperwork problem. Sort case folders, decipher damaged labels and put the archive in order alone or with up to 3 friends. Pass audits and upgrade your skills in a first-person filing game where every folder needs a home.
